title: Ilaaliyaha Calaamad Rabbaani ah
intro: Gudaha meel quduus ah, nafta barakeysan waxaa lagu koriyay daryeel rabbaani ah. Qofkan waxaa loogu talagalay inuu door muhiim ah ka ciyaaro dhacdo mucjiso ah, isagoo noqonaya markhaati u ah awoodda iyo xikmadda aan xad lahayn ee Alle. Safarkoodu wuxuu shaaca ka qaaday xaqiiqo qoto dheer, isagoo caqabad ku ah aragtiyaha iyo aasaaska calaamad gaar ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan aadanaha.
clues: Alle ayaa i doortay oo iga nadiifiyay dhammaan dumarka waqtigayga.
Waxaa la i hoos geeyay nebi xaq ah, kaasoo si mucjiso ah u helay quudin qolkayga salaadda.
Waxaan ka soocay qoyskayga meel gaar ah si aan u caabudo Alle.
Malaa'ig baa ii muuqatay iyadoo nin qumman ah, oo ii sheegaysa wiil daahir ah, inkastoo aanan aqoon nin.
Ka dib markii aan foolanayay, waxaa la i faray inaan ruxo jirridda geedka timirta si aan u helo quud cusub.
Markii aan ku soo laabtay dadkii aan dhalay anigoo sita ilmahayga yar, way i weydiiyeen, laakiin wiilkayga yar ayaa si mucjiso ah uga hadlay ilmahayga isagoo difaacaya.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Daad weyn oo burburiyay qaran gaaloobay.
In lagu tuuro dab ololaya oo beeninaya sanamyada
Dhalashada mucjisada ah ee ilmo aan aabbe lahayn
In nibiri uu liqo isagoo ka tagay hawlgal
Burburinta magaalo sababo la xiriira dhaqamada anshax xumada ah
trial.answer: Dhalashada mucjisada ah ee ilmo aan aabbe lahayn

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Kala-goynta badda si dadku uga gudbaan
Ilmo ka hadlay dhalashadiisa si uu u difaaco waalidkiis
Soo bandhigidda buug rabbaani ah oo hagaya aadanaha
Boqortooyo ay ku barakeysan yihiin dabaysha iyo jinka
outcome.answer: Ilmo ka hadlay dhalashadiisa si uu u difaaco waalidkiis

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
